verdict.rationale: Logseq's docs show a native query feature: `{{query ...}}` simple queries created via `/query`, used for asking questions of the knowledge base. The pack also shows properties exist (e.g. `publish:: true`). However, nothing shows queries filtering on structured properties or rendering results as tables, boards or other database-style views. missing for 10: documented property-based query filters, table/board/list result views, advanced query docs, hands-on corroboration of live views.
